fda-device-z-2478-2026.title: Mito Red Light recall (MITO RED LIGHT INC)
fda-device-z-2478-2026.reason: The near-infrared therapy device contains a lithium-ion battery that may malfunction, causing it to catch fire or burst into flames.
fda-device-z-2478-2026.distribution: Worldwide - US Nationwide distribution including in the states of AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, 	DE, FL, GA, HI, IA, ID, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NJ, NL, NM, 	NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, PR, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV and the countries of Australia, Canada, China, Japan, New Zealand, Spain, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom.
